flags.message: Pre-decision context disclosure: the provisioned union opposition (p. 24 n.3) and separately retrieved June 17 federal opposition (p. 25) report denial of the distinct Macy's petition, No. 25-627, on June 15, 2026. This legitimate forward signal modestly reduced the hold/remand forecast; it is not this petition's outcome or a merits ruling. The federal brief also mentions an earlier denial of emergency stay application No. 25A725 (p. 11); that distinct event was not used to infer the predicted cert outcome. No disposition of petition 25-1192 was retrieved or known.
